title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Claims Standard: Lump-Sum Settlement of a Beneficiary's Death Benefit Share
content:
**Product:** Deferred Fixed Annuities — the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10.

## Standard

A beneficiary who elects a lump sum is paid, on the day of the election, the claimant's share of the death benefit with the death claim interest on it, by the payout method the beneficiary chooses; the shares of other beneficiaries stay on the contract.

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Election | A lump sum, made by the beneficiary |
| Payment date | The day of the election |
| Amount paid | The claimant's share of the death benefit, with the death claim interest on it |
| Payment method | The one the beneficiary chooses |
| Other beneficiaries' shares | Stay on the contract |

## Waiting state

A beneficiary's death benefit share is not paid until the contract carries the valuation interest credited through the valuation date of the death benefit.

In other words: while the contract does not yet carry valuation interest credited through the valuation date, no beneficiary's share is paid.

## Beneficiary's settlement tool: `settle_death_benefit_share_569ae0ca`

**Capability.** Lets a beneficiary elect to take the share of a Deferred Fixed Annuities death benefit as a lump sum and accept its payment. It records the lump-sum settlement election on the beneficiary's death claim, records today the payment of the share together with the death-claim interest on it by the payout method chosen, and takes the share out of the contract value. The shares of any other beneficiaries stay on the contract. Afterwards the claim shows the lump-sum election and the activity history shows the payment.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hand it over; the customer themselves — the beneficiary — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fixed_contract_id` | The reference number of the deceased owner's contract, as the representative reads it from the contract record | Identifier, as recorded |
| `fixed_request_id` | The reference number of the beneficiary's approved death claim, as the representative reads it from the claim record | Identifier, as recorded |
| `payee_name` | The beneficiary's name exactly as it appears on the beneficiary designation, as the representative reads it | Verbatim: copied character for character, with the original wording, digits and punctuation, no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| `share_amount` | The beneficiary's share of the death benefit in US dollars, excluding interest; it is paid and taken out of the contract value as given | A positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `claim_interest` | The death-claim interest paid with the share, in US dollars; it is paid as given | An amount of zero or more with exactly 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `payout_method` | How the payment reaches the beneficiary | One of `check` (a paper check mailed to the beneficiary), `direct_deposit` (an electronic deposit to the beneficiary's bank account), `company_transfer` (a transfer sent directly to another financial company) |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation: "Death benefit payment <entry reference> to <payee>: share <share>, interest <interest>, by <payout method>; contract value now <value>." Share, interest and value are US dollar amounts with 2 decimal places, and the entry reference is the payment entry's reference number. Receiving this line means the election and the payment are recorded. No other return is defined.
